author: glisovic01
description: Outlined rounded gray submit button that slides on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #fff to #272727, transform becomes translateX(0).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Purple Shrimp 29</title>
<style>
/* Purple Shrimp 29 by glisovic01 — https://uiverse.io/glisovic01/purple-shrimp-29 */
.btn {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #fff;
  margin: 1rem auto;
  padding: 0.7rem 2rem;
  border-radius: 30em;
  border-style: none;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-decoration: none;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  background-color: transparent;
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 12px #000000;
}

.btn::before {
  content: "";
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  background-color: #fff;
  transform: translateX(-101%);
  transition: all .3s ease;
  z-index: -1;
}

.btn:hover {
  color: #272727;
  transition: all .3s ease;
}

.btn:hover::before {
  transform: translateX(0);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn">
  submit
</button>

</body>
</html>
